card.name: Until after a dosing schedule
card.fires_on: The word "until" (rarely "at") right after a dosing schedule in oncology labels, where it introduces the stopping point such as disease progression or unacceptable toxicity.

modes.label: Until after a regimen
modes.description: "until" follows a dose, route and frequency and leads into the stop condition.
modes.example: Administer SYLVANT 11 mg/kg over 1 hour as an intravenous infusion every 3 weeks<< until>> treatment failure.

modes.label: Time point in response wording
modes.description: "at" after a response status, introducing the end of treatment.
